previous_last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for experimental cycle-profile ignition angle conversion. decisions.rationale: Adds an opt-in cycle-profile angle conversion for ignition charge and firing while retaining Legacy as the default; timing requirements and fallback need operator guidance.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Experimental cycle-profile conversion is opt-in, uses supported missing-tooth rising-edge history and falls back to Legacy timing.

[firmware/controllers/trigger/ignition_cycle_profile.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/trigger/ignition_cycle_profile.cpp): Recent tooth timing builds the cycle profile and resets on synchronization changes.

[firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini): Ignition scheduling exposes Legacy and Cycle profile (experimental).

last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for experimental causal time-budget dwell planning. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); guide target for a separate docs PR: docs/11-Ignition/Ignition-Settings/Experimental-Timing.md (not claimed public here). The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Adds opt-in causal time-budget dwell planning with occurrence ownership and physical-deadline bounds; Legacy remains default, but eligibility and retarget limits need guidance.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Time-budget planning requires individual coils and keeps Legacy fallback; each target is tied to one TDC occurrence.

[firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/ignition_retarget.h](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/ignition_retarget.h): Retargeting enforces causal ETA, minimum dwell and the physical output deadline.

[firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp): Superseded callback generations are invalidated before replacement callbacks are registered.
